resolvedDecisions.answer: Minimally extend the delivery list response with the existing backend BookOrder.derivedStatus computation. Do not derive order status on the frontend. If reusing the authoritative backend logic proves disproportionate during implementation, omit the order badge and record that assumption instead of introducing a second status algorithm.
Render only genuinely supported flows. Do not add Add book, Change price, or atomic Cancel order actions, and do not emulate unsupported behavior with chained mutations.
resolvedDecisions.specRef: Order menu and book menu action lists

resolvedDecisions.answer: The shipment overflow menu contains Edit shipment and Cancel shipment. Mark shipment as received stays a separate CTA. Other shipment transitions may appear only when already supported and appropriate for the current status.
